sources.authority: National Crime Records Bureau, Ministry of Home Affairs via data.gov.in
used_for: source-discovery only; no numerical city stats copied into this pack
sources.note: The public catalog identifies aggregate 2023 crime statistics. City-year/categorical rows must be extracted from the official NCRB tables and validated before charting; these are annual aggregates, not current/live cases.

used_for: reference for city-wise IPC/SLL/combined tables; not parsed in this pack
sources.note: Do not populate chart values until exact Nagpur metropolitan city rows and table headings are checked.

used_for: public instance access and attribution details

policy.real_data_available: Official public station directory/contact information and published aggregate report source links are bundled.
policy.not_bundled: Real-time police incidents, real FIRs, victim identities, private complaint contents, secure command dashboard data, live dispatch feeds, or records behind login.
policy.demo_data_rule: Every incident/report/dispatch fixture is synthetic and must retain is_demo=true plus visible DEMO labels.
policy.do_not_misrepresent: Never relabel local SOS/demo records as official Nagpur Police records. A directory source does not imply police integration or authorization.
